statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the array-form of the integer val(num) + k. That is: (a) len(r) >= 1; (b) for every i with 0 <= i < len(r), 0 <= r[i] <= 9; (c) r[0] != 0; (d) val(r) = val(num) + k, where val(a) = sum_{i=0}^{len(a)-1} a[i] * 10^{len(a)-1-i} for any digit array a.
preconditions: 1 <= len(num) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(num), 0 <= num[i] <= 9; if len(num) > 1 then num[0] != 0 (no leading zeros except for the single zero); 1 <= k <= 10000.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(num) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(num), 0 <= num[i] <= 9; if len(num) > 1 then num[0] != 0 (no leading zeros except for the single zero); 1 <= k <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) >= len(num).
preconditions: 1 <= len(num) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(num), 0 <= num[i] <= 9; if len(num) > 1 then num[0] != 0 (no leading zeros except for the single zero); 1 <= k <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) <= max(len(num), 5) + 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(num) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(num), 0 <= num[i] <= 9; if len(num) > 1 then num[0] != 0 (no leading zeros except for the single zero); 1 <= k <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r[len(r)-1] = (num[len(num)-1] + k) mod 10.
preconditions: 1 <= len(num) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(num), 0 <= num[i] <= 9; if len(num) > 1 then num[0] != 0 (no leading zeros except for the single zero); 1 <= k <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, (sum_{i=0}^{len(r)-1} r[i]) mod 9 = (sum_{i=0}^{len(num)-1} num[i] + k) mod 9.
preconditions: 1 <= len(num) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(num), 0 <= num[i] <= 9; if len(num) > 1 then num[0] != 0 (no leading zeros except for the single zero); 1 <= k <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and len(r) > len(num), then r[0] = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(num) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(num), 0 <= num[i] <= 9; if len(num) > 1 then num[0] != 0 (no leading zeros except for the single zero); 1 <= k <= 10000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if k < 10 and num[len(num)-1] + k < 10, then len(r) = len(num), r[len(num)-1] = num[len(num)-1] + k, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(num)-1, r[i] = num[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(num) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(num), 0 <= num[i] <= 9; if len(num) > 1 then num[0] != 0 (no leading zeros except for the single zero); 1 <= k <= 10000.
